description: Configure VSCode workspace settings to exclude heavy directories from file watching, search, and explorer to improve performance. You have a large monorepo at /home/ga/workspace/monorepo_project that is making VSCode slow. Create or modify the file /home/ga/workspace/monorepo_project/.vscode/settings.json to add exclusion patterns. You must configure THREE settings, each excluding ALL FIVE directories: (1) files.watcherExclude - add patterns for: node_modules, build, .venv, vendor, logs. (2) search.exclude - add patterns for: node_modules, build, .venv, vendor, logs. (3) files.exclude - add patterns for: node_modules, build, .venv, vendor, logs. Use glob patterns like **/node_modules/**, **/build/**, **/.venv/**, **/vendor/**, **/logs/**. Each setting should be a JSON object where keys are the glob patterns and values are true. Save the file when done.
